title: No this time its the actual tired not the metaphorical one.
description: I called it, oh god this is bad.
content:
Guess who got two hours of sleep last night and wants to vent!!!!
Sort of me; I'm not sold on that second bit. z⁠ᶻ⁠ ⁠૮⁠˶⁠-⁠ ⁠ﻌ⁠ ⁠-⁠˶⁠ა⁠⌒⁠)⁠ᦱ

Seriously, what the hell happened last night? I went to bed tired, not ratshit but just eepy. BUT nooooooooooooooooo brain and body went “haha wouldn't it be funny if we kept you up till 4 am?”
Im so tired now, not the metaphorical one, the actual one- my eyes swollen and I'm supporting my head with a Fanta Raspberry bottle. AND I'M STILL AT WORK.

I had energy, idk why, got stuff done. If you're reading this, you may notice the “Full Post” button I should probably rename. Anyway, the site now has comments built, and I have an admin page to reply/delete as needed. A lot of fun, but the last of the dex is fading, and now I want to shrivel.
I also want to be social; I joined cozy.talk, and it's been really nice ಥ_ಥ. I have notifications sitting on my second monitor I just unfortunately don't have energy for, and that makes me sad. It's a cool place.
Anyway, other life things: I got more moon photos last night; site is fun, likely switching to Linux at home… Oh, and we have two cats at home now 🩵

title: I'm still 'tired'.
description: It really is an accomplishment to still be trying.
content:
I made it, i think this site will be good for me once I'm able to be social again. But right now, I'm still tired. Something has gone horribly wrong and there's nowhere to turn to. I shouldn't feel nothing after 1 coffee, 20mg Dex, and 2 monsters. This is a new all time low.
But, I'm here, I'm still trying. I need to be proud of myself for that, it really is an accomplishment to still be trying.

title: Do I retreive the past?
description: Not in a metaphorical way for once. But of course, the rebuild and stuff.
content:
Not in a metaphorical way for once. But of course, the rebuild and stuff and... Well, anyway let's catch up first.

First, what happened, where was I? Simple, therapy and breakdowns got bad. That's as much as i need to say because there is not much more truth than that.
Growth and healing are the only reasons I'm back. Maybe I'll talk more, but for now, that's enough.

Why the rebuild? Because the site was fine, but I've learnt a lot. More build, more context, strip the DB, setup dynamic JS.
It's nice to rebuild and use improvement.

So, what is the plan? Rebuild, explore, and upgrade. So, I want to add in Math education, Programing Education, Art will be upgraded, Crochet to be added, and CosmikHysteria will be rebuilt once I am able to go back to it.

That's it really. A rebuild has happened and I'm slowly getting better. Very Slowly.
As for retrieve the past? Nah, I think it's better off dead.

title: Where should they start?
description: Does it make sense to even ask?
content:
Does it make sense to even ask? I mean how many points make sense? Does it even make sense again to ask about is it worth starting from a point that makes sense?

Ok let's see where would work:
  1. How about the literal beginning before Dawn?
    No, that's not a great choice, too esoteric with context best explained after some time with the regular events.
  2. What about just after Dawn?
    No, the beginning of Aelveyris requires Dawn context.
  3. Then start in Dawn?
    Not too many characters are better shown later on.
  4. Skip it all and start with Dusk?
    Not starting with the end just doesn't feel right. Plus, Dusk holds too much.
  5. TLS was kind of the beginning to them, why not there?
    If they did, we would still need to narrow further, and it does also feel more disconnected now.
  6. Would anywhere be satisfying for everyone?
    Of course not, everyone is different.
  7. Then why does it matter?
    It truly didn't matter; all that mattered was some start.
Even if the start was from a character, no one will hear from for a long time. Even if this won't make sense for a long time. Even if no one cares.
It's at least started now.

title: How could i ever explain?
description: To tell it in a way im capeable of, it will feel very scattered.
content:
The sun rises, we try again. Darkest before the Dawn. How do I eplain this creation I myself derive from. They were my parts, My Exiles, My Managers, My Firefighters.
That wasent the plan, i didnt know what i was doing purely by accident. Whilst helpful now... the story exists and i must tell it.
I know the story, but to tell it in a way im capeable of, it will feel very scattered.
